title: feat(v31fill): four of eight F_cut fillers fire vertex3
science: Same shape as #6402 on an orthogonal bit, not a probe cell: N_v31=4 of the 8 F_cut 1-site fillers have f(vertex3)=1, with f_sharp (f_L1 silent on the mixed-triple orbit (1,1,1)) as the second witness, filling with the identical history (1,4,8,11,12) T=4. IMPORTANT structural observation the notes do not state: reading the reported bit vectors, the 8 F_cut fillers are exactly the subcube {b_1unbalanced=1, b_2unbalanced=1} with the three bits b_opp2, b_mixed3, b_vertex3 free (2^3=8). So BOTH #6402's N_opp0=4 and this N_v31=4 are forced halvings of that subcube, not independent measurements - each just fixes one free coordinate. These two are the lowest-information members of the chain.
